mapper.sql: g.id AS grant_id,r.parent_tenant_id AS actor_tenant_id,g.target_tenant_id,g.action,g.status,g.revision,g.relation_ref,r.revision AS relation_revision

FROM nw_institution_management_grants g JOIN nw_institution_relation_revisions r ON r.id=g.relation_ref AND r.child_tenant_id=g.target_tenant_id AND g.actor_domain='tenant' AND g.actor_ref=concat('tenant:',r.parent_tenant_id::text) WHERE g.action IN('tenant.agent_deployments.read','tenant.agent_deployments.create','tenant.agent_deployments.bind','tenant.agent_deployments.switch_authorization', 'tenant.sub_institutions.usage_summary.read','tenant.sub_institutions.usage_details.read','tenant.sub_institutions.usage_events.read')

choose.when: AND r.parent_tenant_id IN #{id} AND g.target_tenant_id IN #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT AND g.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF g
SELECT id AS tenant_id,status FROM nw_tenants WHERE id IN(#{actor},#{target}) AND status<>'internal' ORDER BY id FOR SHARE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_institution_management_grants WHERE actor_domain='tenant' AND actor_ref=concat('tenant:',#{actor}::text) AND target_tenant_id=#{target} AND action=#{action} AND relation_ref=#{relation} AND status='active')
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_institution_management_grants SET status='revoked',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active' AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.sql: FROM nw_institution_management_grants g JOIN nw_institution_relation_revisions r ON r.id=g.relation_ref AND r.child_tenant_id=g.target_tenant_id JOIN nw_tenants child ON child.id=g.target_tenant_id AND child.parent_tenant_id=#{actor} AND child.relation_revision=r.revision JOIN nw_tenants hq ON hq.id=#{actor} AND r.parent_tenant_id=hq.id WHERE g.actor_domain='tenant' AND g.actor_ref=concat('tenant:',#{actor}::text) AND g.action=#{action} AND g.status='active' AND child.status IN('active','warning') AND hq.status IN('active','warning')
mapper.select: SELECT AND g.target_tenant_id=#{target} FOR SHARE OF g,child,hq
